messages:
Maria: quick sync — want to lock down the SI co-sell ruleset for Q2 before we push the marketplace private-offer flow. short convo only pls.
Ashok: SGTM. what's the main friction right now?
Maria: two things: (1) overlapping claims when an SI and field both engage same ACV account, (2) private offers in marketplace not showing SI attribution consistently.
Jordan: overlapping claims: we're seeing 40% overlap on demo-stage accounts. needs a clear tie-breaker.
Sam: propose: first-touch rule + 72h claim window for inbound marketplace leads, and 14-day active-engagement window after claim to prevent churn/steal.
Nora: sounds reasonable. how do we handle field-introduced deals vs SI-introduced?
Ashok: field-introduced = field gets priority if they logged a contact in SFDC within 7 days of lead creation. SI-introduced via partner portal or PRM gets priority if they have signed MOU in last 30 days.
Maria: add-on: if both parties have active opportunities (stage >= demo) we escalate to AE/SE for adjudication and lock claims until decided.
partner-bot: [marketplace] New private offer created: ACME Private Offer (opportunity link: https://marketplace.redwood/offer/ACME-789)
Sam: @Jordan can you confirm the mapping flow for private offers? We need offer -> SI -> SFDC account mapping to be automatic.
Jordan: yes — plan is: when private offer is created, PRM webhook writes mapping record to /partner-mappings table. if account fuzzy-match fails, it posts to #partnerships with a review button.
Nora: for fuzzy-match rules, recommend: company name exact OR domain exact OR manual match. if no match, 48h auto-unassigned.
Ashok: edge case: multi-brand orgs (acme / acme-cloud). we should let SI claim sub-accounts if parent account owner approves.
Maria: agree. need one-pager for ops + playbook so sales + PS know steps. I'll draft.
Sam: also propose adding a small workflow in Redwood Console: when a private offer maps to an account, show "SI claimed" badge and a small TTL counter for the claim window.
Jordan: can do. ETA: next sprint.
Maria: milestone checklist for doc: 1) claim precedence rules, 2) mapping logic + examples, 3) adjudication flow, 4) dashboard badges/TTL, 5) monitoring (overlap metric). I'll share draft by EOD Thur.
Ashok: thanks — I'll pull sample SFDC cases and send 3 edge examples.
Nora: +1 to examples. I'll add SE adjudication script.
Sam: :thumbsup: can we also add a note about private-offer discounts that require sales leadership sign-off?
Maria: yep. include approval matrix.
Ashok: ok I'm good. anyone objection to publish as beta to partners next week?
Jordan: no objections.
Nora: no objections.
Maria: cool — beta rollout next Tue, quick feedback window of 2 weeks. flag any blockers here. :rocket:
